answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: unforgeable continuity. Each identity's actions form an append-only hash chain rooted in its key, each entry committing to the last, so history spirals forward and cannot be spliced, forked, or transplanted. An attacker cannot mint a fake at dawn and graft a credible past onto it, nor buy an aged identity and rebind it to a new key: verification breaks. Every fake starts with an empty, provable history that only grows in real time through genuine work. With no market in pre-aged identities to shortcut, the nectar of standing is earned forward, per key, from zero.
